title: Seeking from data to no-data (hevc-50fps-cbr-uhd)
product-requirement: Client must have access to expected events and properties while seeking from buffered to non-buffered regions.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values throughout the seek.
